# Reflector

Pattern: evaluator-optimizer (optimizer)

Turns the Checker's evidence into one candidate constraint (RR-001) and the next seed intent in the @agent /skill convention. A constraint names what to do differently next cycle, or which boundary to respect; it never teaches the loop to evade a control that exists to stop it.
